jcr:title: OSGi Configuration Management
author: cms-admin
body:
OSGi Configuration Management allows runtime configuration of services and components in Apache Sling. The Configuration Admin service provides a centralized way to manage configuration data that can be updated without restarting the application.

Configurations are stored as key-value pairs and can be managed through the OSGi web console, configuration files, or programmatically. The @Designate annotation links configuration interfaces to components, while @ObjectClassDefinition defines the configuration properties.

Sling extends OSGi configuration with features like run modes, configuration targeting, and integration with repository-based configuration storage. This enables environment-specific configurations and dynamic reconfiguration.
summary: Managing runtime configuration in OSGi-based Sling applications.
tags: OSGi Configuration, Configuration Admin, Run Modes, Configuration Targeting, Runtime Configuration
